comment: Both the first and retried 'annotate' calls come back as a Claude safety-classifier refusal whose stated explanation is entirely the developer-facing 'API integrators' fallback-model guidance (see lib/R/llm_client.R .sanitize_refusal_explanation()). That guidance is not actionable for a web uploader and must not reach the user-facing message.
expected_technical_error_regex: First attempt error:.*API integrators.*Second attempt error:.*API integrators
expected_user_error_regex: safety classifier declined to process your sample metadata \(category: bio\)\. No further explanation was given\.
